`account_ext` is not touched here: it is an extension table keyed by `account_key` that holds the Workbench decision `dispute_open` and never a copy of an ACE column (BR5), and it belongs to RWB-P1-E1069-DB.

edits.new: 1. A caller of the P1 read contract asks for one account by `account_key` for a business date. The account_key is the business key of the ACE account; the Workbench holds no identifier of its own for it (BR-P1-001-3). The operation is GET /accounts/{id} on /api/recovery/source-data/v1, published by RWB-P1-E1069-APP, one hop, 2 s; this story adds no path of its own (GAP-0549).
